name: RecommendationEmailNotifications
label: Set email notifications for Entra recommendations
helpText: Turns the Microsoft Entra emails about new recommendations on or off for the whole tenant. These are the "You have a new recommendation" emails sent to admins.
executiveText: Controls whether Microsoft emails the tenant's administrators each time Microsoft Entra has a new security recommendation. Turning them off removes notices that are not acted on, for example where the tenant is not managed for security.
docsDescription: Sets the tenant-wide **Send email notifications for tenant recommendations** setting (Microsoft Entra admin center, Overview, Recommendations, Email Settings). Turned off, Entra stops emailing admins when a new recommendation appears; the recommendations themselves are still listed in the admin center.

sendEmails.label: Send email notifications for new recommendations
